# Shared cases: what becomes of a download held by the network policy
# when it is asked again.
#
# Replayed by both implementations, so they cannot drift apart:
#   - native/linthra_core/src/download_held_cases_test.rs (Rust)
#   - test/core/services/download_held_cases_test.dart (Dart)
#
# One case per line, fields separated by a single TAB. `#` starts a comment.
#
#   <same account>  <in flight>  <row>  <action>
#
# row:    - (no row) | queued | downloading | downloaded | failed
# action: retry | drop | dropAndReset

true	false	-	retry
true	false	queued	retry
true	false	downloading	retry
true	false	downloaded	retry
true	false	failed	retry
true	true	-	retry
true	true	queued	retry
true	true	downloading	retry
true	true	downloaded	retry
true	true	failed	retry
false	false	-	drop
false	false	queued	dropAndReset
false	false	downloading	drop
false	false	downloaded	drop
false	false	failed	drop
false	true	-	drop
false	true	queued	drop
false	true	downloading	drop
false	true	downloaded	drop
false	true	failed	drop
